why: Shutterflow's Tauri shell loads whichever UI dir SHUTTERFLOW_UI_DIR names, so a second UI app needs a Makefile switch, a following e2e harness and a DOM test harness; src-tauri never moves.
what: UI_APP switch in the Makefile, the e2e plumbing that follows it, an empty apps/desktop-v3 that builds and runs DOM tests, and scripts/check-port.ts. No feature code.
contract: Read basalt-ui docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md 6.4, shutterflow docs/decisions/0028 (no bulk baseline regeneration) and AGENTS.md safety rule 1 (never read /Volumes). Root pin basalt-ui 1.40.3 stays; apps/desktop-v3 declares exact 3.0.0-next.N (floors.G2.next in basalt-ui scripts/fleet.json) with `basalt.sibling` (v3-cli-sibling). DOM harness (desktop has 67 .test.ts, none DOM): devDependencies happy-dom and @happy-dom/global-registrator at basalt-ui's root pins (`npm view` first); bunfig.toml preloads test/setup.ts (registers the global, calls basalt-ui/testing `installDomShims`); tests use `renderApp`. happy-dom has no layout: geometry is e2e or the owner's eye.
change: Makefile: `UI_APP ?= desktop`, `UI_DIR := $(CURDIR)/apps/$(UI_APP)/dist`, `ui` builds `@shutterflow/$(UI_APP)` plus the gallery. Playwright: with UI_APP not desktop only e2e/desktop/visual/invariants.spec.ts runs (the rest stays Mantine-keyed until the re-key Issues), from the first shell Issue, geometry first, no baseline. Scaffold apps/desktop-v3 (`init --profile app` in the app dir). scripts/check-port.ts <oldDir> <newDir> [--all]: pairs each *.test.ts(x) (every file with --all), strips import statements, exits 1 on any other differing line unless it carries a `// port: <reason>` marker, prints the marker count. One smoke test through renderApp. Rule: the app oxlint preset runs in `make check`'s lint line. Skill snippet: none.
commits: Shutterflow ships by push to master: conventional, one concern each, no attribution. Never edit node_modules or basalt-ui; a gap is a `friction:` line in the PR body.
proof: hygiene.check is false. Gate: the app's typecheck, test and build. This Issue changes package.json, bun.lock and the Makefile, so `make check-changed` falls back to `make check`: state it not-run.
acceptance: `make -n e2e UI_APP=desktop-v3` shows SHUTTERFLOW_UI_DIR ending in apps/desktop-v3/dist and `make -n e2e` still ends in apps/desktop/dist
`bun run --cwd e2e playwright test --list --project visual` with UI_APP=desktop-v3 lists only invariants.spec.ts tests
`bun test scripts/check-port.test.ts` proves: import-only diff passes, unmarked changed line fails, marked one passes and is counted
`git diff --stat origin/master -- apps/desktop apps/desktop/src-tauri e2e/desktop/visual` shows no change
`rg -n mantine apps/desktop-v3` finds nothing; the PR states `make check-changed` not-run
out_of_scope: Any desktop feature, baselines, src-tauri, the gallery, deleting apps/desktop.
